findings.title: C3 Violation: Hard-coded status defaults remain in repair_crm_configuration fallback
findings.description: Lines 445–454 in backend/app/services/laya_system1.py contain hard-coded ['New', 'Active', 'Completed'] defaults that violate the C3 requirement to remove fallback status lists. The fallback path is reachable via groq_provider.py and ollama_provider.py when LLM returns incomplete entity data.
findings.consequence: System injects hard-coded sales-specific statuses for any industry when entity data is incomplete, violating schema-driven requirement
findings.correction: Remove hard-coded array and either: (1) raise explicit error, (2) generate stages using _generate_pipeline_stages(), or (3) read from configuration if available

findings.title: C5 Violation: Hard-coded won stage assumptions persist in _generate_pipeline_stages
findings.description: Lines 562–563 in backend/app/services/laya_system1.py contain hard-coded 'Closed Won' and 'Closed Lost' stage names, violating C5 requirement to remove fixed outcome-stage assumptions. This method generates universal pipeline stages but embeds sales-specific terminology.
findings.consequence: Universal analytics cannot reliably derive outcome metrics without explicit CRM metadata; outcome-stage assumptions remain hard-coded instead of configuration-driven
findings.correction: Remove hard-coded stage names; add explicit success_stage/failure_stage metadata to CRM configuration; if not available, omit or indicate 'not configured'

findings.title: Missing 're' module import causes test failure
findings.description: backend/app/services/ai_provider.py line 61 uses re.search() but module is not imported. Causes NameError in test_phase9_regression.py::TestProviderSelection::test_mock_provider_returns_valid_config
findings.correction: Add 'import re' to the top of the file
